capabilities.description: Unified portfolio and program management across enterprise and corporate technology initiatives, with rollup views, initiative registry, shared ownership of goals, and governance workflows for stage gates, approvals, and decision logging.

Supports both agile and waterfall delivery models in one workspace: agile team cadences, release train and scrum ceremonies, sprints, backlogs, and dependencies alongside waterfall phases, project managers, business analysts, work breakdown structures, and gate-based milestones.

Integrated planning, scheduling, milestone management, dependency tracking, and critical path visibility across programs, with what-if scenarios and readiness checks for go-live and release milestones.
Demand intake, scoring, and prioritization of technology initiatives, with resource and capacity alignment across teams, roles, and vendors to match supply to prioritized demand.
Budget and financial guardrail tracking within approved parameters, including forecasts, actuals, variance alerts, benefits tracking, and value realization reporting tied to initiative outcomes.
KPI monitoring for team effectiveness, delivery performance, stakeholder feedback, and adoption, with continuous improvement analytics, trend detection, and recommendation templates for remediation.

Enterprise integration with Oracle applications and ERP platforms for finance, HR, procurement, and project accounting, including data synchronization, event-driven interfaces, and certified connectors.
GDPR and data privacy compliance controls, including data subject request workflows, consent and retention tracking, evidence capture, document handling, and verifiable audit trails for regulators.

summary: A unified enterprise delivery and portfolio management platform purpose-built for a digitally native airline, inspired by the Riyadh Air enterprise technology portfolio mandate.
